doc: Given a u16 index arg0, looks up D_8006CE80[arg0].unk04 (a pointer to an inner record). If non-null, reads unk04->unk0C (a pointer to a null-terminated array of s32 values). If that list is non-empty, calls func_80041284() on each element in turn until a 0 terminator is reached.

globals.name: D_8006CE80
globals.decl: struct S_8006CE80 { s32 unk00; S_8006CE80_inner *unk04; s32 unk08; } D_8006CE80[100]; /* 12-byte elements; only unk04 (offset 4, pointer to inner record) is accessed by this function; unk00/unk08 are unconfirmed padding/fields */

calls: func_80041284(s32) - called with each non-null s32 element from the list
